note: TestRFC7440ClientWindowOneIsLockstep now uses the shared shortenTFTP (tftpTimeout 1 s, expectACK waits 500 ms). With windowsize 1, every DATA must draw its own ACK within tftpTimeout/2, before the next DATA is sent, so lockstep timing is now bounded. Block 3, sent while block 2 is expected, must draw nothing for 300 ms and must not be written, and the file must hold each block once. Observed red under the overlay mutant that ignores the granted windowsize: 'client sent 00 04 00 01, want nothing'.
